WITH cte AS (
  SELECT BTP.PORTFOLIO_NO, BTP.ACC_NO, BTP.BASE_NO,BTP.IsLatest,BTP.IsActive,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY BTP.PORTFOLIO_NO, BTP.ACC_NO, BTP.BASE_NO ORDER BY BTP.PORTFOLIO_NO) AS DUP_COUNT
  FROM BUSC.TRU_PORTFOLIO_20240125 BTP
  LEFT JOIN BUSC.TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION BTPS ON BTP.SUBSCRIPTION_ID = BTPS.SUBSCRIPTION_ID AND BTP.BASE_NO = BTPS.BASE_NO
  WHERE BTP.PORTFOLIO_NO IS NOT NULL AND BTP.isLatest = '1'
) SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BUSC_TRU_PORTFOLIO FROM cte
UPDATE TGT 
SET
  [IsActive] = CASE
    WHEN DELTA.DUP_COUNT > 1 THEN 0
    ELSE 1 END
FROM BUSC.TRU_PORTFOLIO_20240125 TGT 
JOIN #TEMP_BUSC_TRU_PORTFOLIO DELTA
ON TGT.PORTFOLIO_NO = DELTA.PORTFOLIO_NO
  AND TGT.ACC_NO = DELTA.ACC_NO
  AND TGT.BASE_NO = DELTA.BASE_NO
